read_problems.text: The quantity dose_to_size_mJ_cm2 is set to a literal constant across patterns rather than solved via deterministic root finding.
read_problems.note: The plan defines dose-to-size as the deterministic incident dose at which calibrated developed critical dimension matches the target critical dimension for each pattern pair.
read_problems.fix: Implement deterministic root finding over incident dose on the mean latent image to match the developed critical dimension to the target critical dimension for each pattern.
read_problems.name: dose_to_size_mJ_cm2

read_problems.text: The sinusoidal aerial image for lines has an intensity minimum at the center row where line metrics samples target line labels.
read_problems.note: Sampling the unexposed intensity valley instead of an exposure peak causes false line break detections on every trial without bridging noise.
read_problems.fix: Shift the phase of the line aerial image so that an intensity peak aligns with the center row, or sample target line labels at an intensity peak location.
read_problems.name: break_probability_per_um

read_problems.text: Line edge and width roughness are extracted across the full image height rather than isolating the target line component.
read_problems.note: The domain spans multiple line periods, so taking global minimum and maximum rows per column measures across separate lines rather than the target line edge.
read_problems.fix: Filter the column edge search to only pixels belonging to the connected component of the target line.
read_problems.name: ler_3sigma_nm

read_problems.text: The 95% bootstrap confidence interval for safe dose crossing is returned as null in tail_fit.
read_problems.note: The plan defines the estimand of each safe dose metric to include its 95% bootstrap uncertainty interval.
read_problems.fix: Compute the bootstrap confidence interval of the crossing dose by resampling trials or parameter estimates and recording the empirical quantiles.
read_problems.name: safe_dose_bridge_1e6_mJ_cm2

read_problems.text: The complementary log-log tail fitting restricts the slope parameter to strictly negative values and rejects non-negative slopes.
read_problems.note: Line breaks and merged contacts increase in probability with exposure dose, requiring a positive slope parameter to model their defect tail.
read_problems.fix: Adjust the optimization bounds and convergence checks to allow positive slope parameters for defect mechanisms that increase with dose.
read_problems.name: safe_dose_break_1e6_mJ_cm2

read_problems.text: Preflight check outcomes in the results dictionary are populated with null and literal placeholder values rather than actual check results.
read_problems.note: The plan requires reporting the verified outcome of the preflight checks, but the aggregation script discards check cells and writes static values.
read_problems.fix: Collect the actual check results returned by the trial runner for each check cell and insert them into the preflight results dictionary.
read_problems.name: preflight

read_problems.text: The function apply_blur_and_develop evaluates development only at the central pixel rather than returning the two-dimensional developed field.
read_problems.note: Equation E4 defines development as a full two-dimensional field over the spatial coordinates.
read_problems.fix: Return the complete thresholded two-dimensional array instead of indexing at the central pixel.
read_problems.name: E4

read_problems.text: A scalar absorbed photon count is drawn using model.draw_absorbed_photons but the result is discarded and never used.
read_problems.note: Photon absorption across the domain is drawn directly from the two-dimensional Poisson rate field, making the scalar call redundant.
read_problems.fix: Remove the unused scalar draw assignment.
read_problems.name: E2
